## Checklist
Before submitting this pull request, please ensure you have completed the following checks:

- [ ] **Semantic HTML5:** All pages use appropriate semantic landmark tags (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<article>`, `<footer>`).
- [ ] **Relative File Paths:** All internal links, stylesheet references (`style.css`), scripts, and image sources utilize valid relative paths (e.g., `../assets/...` or `assets/...`).
- [ ] **No Hardcoded Machine Paths:** Verified there are zero local machine file paths (e.g., `C:\`, `D:\`, or `file:///`).
- [ ] **Accessible Images:** All images (`<img>`) include descriptive `alt` attributes or `alt=""` for purely decorative visuals.
- [ ] **Responsive Design:** Layout displays properly across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports without horizontal clipping.
- [ ] **Theme Compatibility:** Elements render legibly and maintain high contrast in both light and dark modes.
- [ ] **Form & Interactive Accessibility:** Form controls feature associated `<label>` elements or accessible `aria-label` attributes.
